findings.title: Dual orchestrator trees (legacy vs engines)
findings.detail: Legacy pipeline/agents/vcs/utils and new engines/* coexist causing drift and regression maintenance burden.

findings.title: God-modules
findings.detail: cli/handlers.py, full_pipeline.py, sentinel/*, OrchestratorConfig are monolithic.

findings.title: Concrete SDK leak through protocol layer
findings.detail: core/protocols.py imports openhands.sdk.Agent directly, breaking abstraction.

findings.title: Circular import risk
findings.detail: orchestrator.py <-> pipeline.dispatcher imports are fragile.

findings.title: Config schema drift
findings.detail: 4 overlapping sources of truth (schema.py, config_schema.json, orchestrator.config.json, core/config.py).

findings.title: Compiled UI bundles committed
findings.detail: ui/web/dist assets should be build artifacts not source-controlled.

findings.title: Documentation & worktree bloat
findings.detail: Stale phase plans and full .kilo/worktrees duplicate committed to repo.

findings.title: Secret redaction regex not anchored
findings.detail: Generic sk- regex over-redacts and false-positives on non-key text.

findings.title: Operator deny-list substring matching
findings.detail: Check-only deny-list with raw substring matching can allow/deny incorrectly.

findings.title: No workspace boundary on file read commands
findings.detail: cat/ls/type/dir/get-content allowed without boundary check; is_sensitive_filepath not enforced on every command.

findings.title: Env enumeration leakage in redaction
findings.detail: Replaces sensitive env values and embeds key names, leaking presence; O(N*M).

findings.title: JWT regex trailing optional segments
findings.detail: Final .?[...]* permits zero-length segments causing odd partial redaction.

findings.title: No allow-list bypass fuzz tests
findings.detail: No test matrix enumerating APPROVED_ROOT_COMMANDS x DISALLOWED_OPERATORS.

findings.title: .env committed and exfiltration risk
findings.detail: .env present at repo root; cat .env via agent can exfiltrate provider keys.

findings.title: Free-tier fallback fragility
findings.detail: Default fallback chain uses free models; MAX_BUDGET_USD=0.50 may exceed before governor trips; need pre-check.

findings.title: Autonomous self-heal default
findings.detail: self_healing_level=full_autonomous default; recommend human_in_the_loop for first release.

findings.title: API keys not SecretStr
findings.detail: API key fields serializable to JSON; use pydantic.SecretStr to prevent repr/log leakage.

findings.title: max_iterations Union typing defect
findings.detail: Union[int,str] with raw string fallback; numeric comparison raises TypeError.

findings.title: workspace_path frozen at import
findings.detail: Resolved at class-definition time; late env set not reflected.

findings.title: Unvalidated environment_variables injection
findings.detail: DomainProfile.environment_variables injected into agent subprocesses without validation.

findings.title: Config option divergence
findings.detail: Options added to one schema source but not others silently fail.

findings.title: Module-import side effect load_dotenv
findings.detail: load_dotenv() at import masks bugs where tests expect isolated env.

findings.title: Task queue IN_PROGRESS state not recovered
findings.detail: run_tasks interleaves saves; crash mid-task leaves queue IN_PROGRESS with no recovery path.

findings.title: Mock-detection in production code
findings.detail: hasattr(run,'_mock_self') is a fragile test leak; use an injection point.

findings.title: Unbounded task queue growth
findings.detail: stop_on_failure=False with many failures grows queue without pruning.

findings.title: Inconsistent return typing run_task vs run_tasks
findings.detail: Single returns dict, batch returns Dict[str,Any].

findings.title: Silent workspace file-to-parent fallback
findings.detail: raw_ws.is_file() falls back to parent dir, masking user path errors.

findings.title: Hardcoded env overrides in CLI
findings.detail: COLUMNS=160, log levels set before user override; user config ignored.

findings.title: sentinel-heal accepts unbounded path
findings.detail: --sentinel-heal with const='.' combined with S-03 can traverse full filesystem and mutate AST.

findings.title: Flat CLI with no subcommands
findings.detail: 20+ top-level flags, no subcommands; poor discoverability.

findings.title: Diagnostics telemetry committed to repo
findings.detail: diagnostics/memory & reports contain runtime payloads; partial redaction may leak secrets.

findings.title: git worktree duplicate committed
findings.detail: .kilo/worktrees/bead-handle full duplicate incl .git committed; bloats clones.

findings.title: Stale UI dist in HEAD
findings.detail: Hashed JS bundles committed; stale UI can be served.

findings.title: No CI gate on security hardening tests
findings.detail: security fuzzing & permission escalation tests not required before merge.

recommendations_priority: S-03/S-07/B-12: enforce workspace boundary on all file commands and sentinel-heal
B-01: replace max_iterations Union with int + mode flag
S-01: tighten sk- regex + fuzz test
A-01: deprecate legacy tree in favor of engines
S-10: use SecretStr for API keys
B-06: add queue recovery for IN_PROGRESS tasks
A-03: remove openhands.sdk.Agent import from protocols
B-14: gitignore diagnostics and prune on clean
